text:
Emma L: quick ops check — planning to flip a client-surface feature gate for 'fast_cache' today. Need a final decision on canary audience, min SDK version, and graceful fallback. My proposal: 5% user bucketing (by user-id) for 2h, SDK min version 1.4.0, fallback = feature off when header absent. SDK should emit telemetry key rw.fast_cache.sent boolean. Watch: cache-hit-rate and error-rate. Thoughts?

Raj P: +1 on user-id bucketing. Avoid org-level sampling (we've seen correlated spikes). Also we should exclude Dedicated customers who opted out of experimental flags — I'll add an allowlist/denylist server-side.

Oliver: SDK PR is ready (#542). It will set header: `X-Redwood-Flags: fast_cache=on;v=1`. Backcompat: if SDK <1.4.0 it won't send the header. Added telemetry metric rw.fast_cache_sent_count so we can count senders.

Ciara: QA request — can we flip the header to 100% for my test org in staging so I can run mobile+web e2e and perf sweeps? I'll validate cache warmup behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging -> canary -> prod. Awaiting approvals: @Emma L, @Raj P.

Emma L: I'll approve once staging smoke passes. Raj — can you add env allowlist var, e.g. REDWOOD_FEATURE_ALLOWLIST_FAST_CACHE=org:acme,org:beta ?

Raj P: Added server-side check and config flag. Also added a rollbar tag `feature:fast_cache_canary` and a tracing span attribute rw.fast_cache=true so traces filter easily.

Oliver: small implementation note — header parser accepts semicolon-delimited pairs; example SDK snippet: ```js
headers['X-Redwood-Flags'] = 'fast_cache=on;v=1';
``` Ensure server parser tolerates extra whitespace and missing `v` param.

Ciara: QA warning — watch for cache warmup causing initial latency spike. Suggest perf alert: p50 latency increase >20% OR cache-hit-rate drop >15% -> auto-rollback.

Emma L: roll plan: 5% user bucketing for 2h, if stable (p95 errors < 0.5% and cache-hit-rate up) then 20% for 1h, then 100% next day. Immediate rollback triggers: error-rate delta > 1% absolute, p99 latency +200ms, or surge in 5xxs.

Oliver: PR #542: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/542 — tagging reviewers @Ciara (QA) and @Raj (prod-config).

Ciara: running staging sweep now, will report back in ~30m :eyes:

Raj P: config lgtm from infra side. Emma you have my approval once staging looks good.

Emma L: starting canary ramp in 10m. Will post smoke results & metrics snapshot here.
